 Ghana 0 - 0 Somalia 2027 Afcon qualifiers live updates
 Wia dis foto come from, Getty Images/SOMALIA FOOTBALL FEDERATION 
 Wetin we call dis foto, Somalia dey bottom of Group C, Ghana bin dey third afta dia 2-0 first leg win ova di Ocean Stars Published 16 November 2026, 12:28 WAT New Informate 13 minutes wey don pass Read am in 5 mins Ghana interim coach Kim Lars Björkegren don make five changes to di team wey sama Somalia 2-0 for di first leg for di second fixture.
 Thomas Partey and Caleb Yirenkyi, no dey fit for di game. Na so Ibrahim Sulemana, Ibrahim Rash Rahim and Thomas Brandon-Asante dey start for di Black Stars.
 Somalia head coach Yusuf Ali Nur don also name im starting lineup for dis game wit one change.
 Ghana currently dey third for Group C wit three points from three games.
 Somalia don lose dia first three games.
 Cote D'ivoire bin dey lead di group wit nine points followed by Gambia wey also get six points.
 Di result for dis game go determine di fate of Somalia – if dem lose again, dem no fit qualify for di Afon.
 A win for Ghana go boost dia chances.
 Ghana XI: Lawrence Ati-Zigi (GK); Alidu Seidu, Mohammed Salisu, Gideon Mensah, Ibrahim Rash Rahim, Ibrahim Sulemana, Fatawu Issahaku, Mohammed Kudus, Kojo Peprah Oppong, Thomas Brandon-A sante, Jordan Ayew
 Somalia XI: Ibrahim Ahmed (GK); Abel Gigle, Faisal Abubakar, Ali Omar, Mohamed Hassan, Abdisamad Abdullah, Abdi Sharif, Jarma Mohamed, Mubashir Nour, Bilal Njie, Musse Jailani
 Buildup
 Di Black Stars of Ghana go jam wit Ocean stars of Somalia for di second leg of dia 2027 Group C Afcon qualifiers.
 Ghana sama Somalia 2-0 last week for di first leg to move to third place for di group.
 Wit dat result, Somalia remain bottom for di Group.
 Di two teams go face each oda for Ghana, sake of Somalia no get CAF-approved pitch for international games.
 Tok-tok pesin for di Ghana Football Association (GFA) say dem go ensure say di spectators for di Essipong Stadium no go be more than 10,000.
 "CAF approve di Essipong Stadium wit restrictions - e no suppose take more than 10,000 fans, but for di first leg, dat arrangement no work, na so for di Monday game we go ensure say dem do di right tin," oga Henry Asante Twum bin tok Sporty FM.
 Di National Sports Authority (NSA) say dem go ensure say pipo follow strict protocol for di game.
 Dem also ask ticket holders to follow di instructions for di match day wey students wey get dia valid student Identification card go dey permitted to enta di stadium.

 Goals from Wolfsburg defender Jonas Adjetey and Iğdır FK striker Felix Afena-Gyan secure di 2-0 win for di Black Stars, for di game wey see some of di kontris top players return from injury.
 Somalia coach tok afta dat game say "di game get plenty intensity wey di weather bin dey very hot. We neva get any chances to score, but we go again for Monday Isha Alla."
 Yusuf Ali Nur add say "we no dey give excuse, dis na football. If you lose, you tok say I lose."
 Meanwhile Ghana interim coach Kim Lars Björkegren say di team gatz improve dia finishing.
 Ghana dey chase dia second win ova Somalia in four days – di Ocean stars go hope to win dia first game for dis qualifiers to keep dia hope alive.
 Team news for Ghana and Somalia
 Wia dis foto come from, GFA 
 Wetin we call dis foto, Somalia coach Yusuf Nur dey hope for positive result for dis game Ghana interim coach Kim Lars Björkegren get some headache for dis game as two key players get fitness issues.
 Midfielder Caleb Yirenkyi bin get knock for di first leg game wey im be doubt to play di return leg on Monday.
 Thomas Partey be anoda player wey be doubt; di Al Shabab midfielder wey bury im papa ova di weekend, also get fitness wahala.
 Dis dey mean say di coach gatz rely on oda players to replace dis two for di starting lineup.
 Di GFA say "if Partey and Yirenkyi no pass di fitness test, di coach fit call Ibrahim Sulemana, Ibrahim Rash and Daniel Kofi Kyereh to di squad."
 Apart from dis two, Kim Lars Björkegren dey likely to add few changes.
 Somalia coach Yusuf Ali Nur dey likely to make few changes to im team also, especially afta di physical demands of di first leg.
 Wetin di two coaches tok ahead of di game
 Coach Kim Lars Björkegren say im team dey target dia second win for di qualifiers afta dia difficult start to di campaign.
 Im tok say di players dey hungry to show dia level for dis game in front of di Ghana fans.
 "Di most important tin na to make sure say we take di six points for dis international window, wey if we fit score more goals, e go dey positive for us."
 Di interim coach bin add say "I tink di goal difference go dey important for di end so we gatz make sure we score goals and win games."
 Im also expect wetin im describe as "improved game" from im team.
 "We bin get clear plan for di first game wey we do many tins well, but we tink say we fit do beta for dis next one. We gatz dey more dangerous for di final third."
 Kim Lars Björkegren also say im dey feel di positive vibe among di team.
 "I dey believe in dis group well well; dem dey motivated and hungry to show di world and di fans how good dem be, na so we go see ogbonge performance on Monday."
 For Somalia coach Yusuf Ali Nur, dis game go dey tough well well but im get hope say di team go get positive result.
 "Dis na deadly group, di only group wey get two teams from di World Cup – Ghana and Cote D'ivoire. But we go focus on di task wey dey bifor us Insha Allah we go get di result against Ghana," im tok ahead of di game.
 Captain Abdullahi Abdul Samed say im teammates gatz approach di game wit commitment and determination.
 "We gatz put in di effort, we no get any excuse about di pitch and anytin like dat, we suppose deliver."
 Im add say "di ogbonge Ghana players dey hia, dem sabi wia to stand and when to strike, we don watch dem on top TV now we don experience dem up-close, bit we don meet to gree how to approach dis game."
 Possible starting lineups for Ghana and Somalia
 Ghana XI: Benjamin Asare (GK); Alidu Seidu, Jonas Adjetey, Mohammed Salisu, Gideon Mensah, Ibrahim Sulemana, Daniel Kyereh, Thomas Brandon-Asante, Mohammed Kudus, Felix Afena Gyan, Jordan Ayew
 Somalia XI: Ibrahim Ahmed (GK); Abel Gigle, Faisal Abubakar, Ali Omar, Mohamed Hassan, Abdisamad Abdullah, Abdi Sharif, Mubashir Nour, Sakarya Hassan, Bilal Njie, Musse Jailani
 Di game go happun for di Essipong Stadium for di Western Region of di kontri at 3PM GMT (4PM WAT).
